articleTitle: Sound Source Location Prediction Method Based on Broad Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: In sound source localization technology, the accuracy of localization algorithms has always been a core issue in this field. This paper proposes a microphone array sound source location algorithm based on broad learning algorithm for the Time Difference of Arrival (TDOA) technology in sound source localization (Dynamic), which solves the problems of low positioning accuracy, large computational complexity and low noise resistance in traditional localization algorithms. Unlike the structural form of deep learning, the broad learning system (BLS) is more inclined to construct the network in the "width" direction. Firstly, the audio signals collected by the microphone array are reprocessed, and the Generalized Cross-Correlation (GCC) function is mapped to the feature nodes and enhancement nodes of the broad learning system respectively. Secondly, the feature nodes and enhancement nodes are used as inputs to the neural network to construct the framework of the model. Finally, predicting the position of the sound source. We compare our method with Oneshot algorithm (broad learning without increment) and BP neural network algorithm. The experimental results show that this algorithm not only does not significantly increase the complexity of the algorithm, but also has good positioning performance.

articleTitle: Research on SOTIF Analysis Based on HWP
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: With the rapid development of intelligent connected vehicles and automatic driving technology, safety of the intended functionality (SOTIF) of intelligent connected vehicles equipped with automatic driving functions has become the focus of the industry. Based on the theoretical framework of ISO 21448, this paper takes the Highway Pilot (HWP) function as the research object, analyzes and summarizes safety of the intended functionality through the specification and design, identification and evaluation of hazards, STPA analysis, and the proposed SOTIF requirements, providing the theoretical and analytical basis for subsequent simulation and testing.

articleTitle: Virtual Simulation of Ship Anchor Pulling Test Based on Vortex
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: The anchoring system is an important part of the ship system, which is an indispensable part of the ship ship mooring. With the rapid development of digital shipbuilding, ship-pulling anchor simulation experiments become more and more important. This paper takes a passenger ship as an example, using virtual reality technology, based on analyzing the composition of the ship pulling anchor test equipment and the movement law, with the help of a vortex virtual simulation platform, the simulation scene of the ship pulling anchor test and the movement process program is designed. The designed virtual simulation scheme can realize the human-computer interaction operation and the simulation process of the ship pulling anchor test, to achieve the purpose of replacing the wooden mold test to reduce the loss of manpower and material resources and realize the digital pulling anchor test. It provides an effective way for the further development of anchor-pulling simulation experiment.

articleTitle: Research of Enterprise Private Cloud Video Conference System Based on ‘Middle-Platform+Micro-services’
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: The video conferencing system is one of the most important digital infrastructure for enterprises now, effectively improving communication and collaboration efficiency. However, traditional hardware video conferencing systems have complex technology, high hardware costs, inflexible meeting modes, and strong maintenance professionalism. Public cloud video conferencing systems have significant shortcomings in application effectiveness, full scene access, and operation and maintenance control. Additionally, there is a risk of information leakage in internal decision-making, evaluation, and evaluation meetings involving enterprise secrets. This article proposes a video conference system design scheme based on the "middle platform + Micro-services" architecture of enterprise private cloud, which has strong scalability, flexible and rich application scenarios, low operation and maintenance costs, and high security, greatly meeting the needs of enterprise management.

articleTitle: Trading Strategy Optimisation with a Multi-objective Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Algorithmic trading, a significant area of research in artificial intelligence, faces the challenges of interpreting and processing extensive and dynamic data. This environment is ideal for implementing adaptive algorithms, such as the evolutionary algorithm NSGA-II used in this paper, notable for its effectiveness in multi-objective optimisation problems. We apply this algorithm, in conjunction with technical indicators, to explore and exploit the search space provided by BTC/AUD market data for a specific trading strategy. Our objective is to demonstrate how NSGA-II, with an optimal parameter configuration, can balance net profit and risk to optimise trading outcomes, as evidenced in the Pareto-front results. Our findings show that by optimizing the parameter values, our NSGA-II driven strategy significantly outperformed a buy-and-hold strategy over the same period.

articleTitle: A non-invasive load identification method based on data association learning
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: In order to optimize the performance of load identification, a non-invasive load identification method based on data association learning is proposed. Firstly, collect harmonic components and extract harmonic component information from the electricity data. Then the methods of missing value filling, Outlier processing and normalization are used to preprocess the data to improve the accuracy of load identification. Finally, a non-invasive load identification method based on data association learning was adopted. Through experiments, it was found that the non-invasive load identification method based on data association learning has high accuracy and reliability, and does not require the installation of additional sensors, which will not affect the normal electricity consumption of users, and has high practical value.

articleTitle: An Anti-Polarization-Fading Method for a Grating Array Underwater Acoustic Demodulation System
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: The grating array fiber optic hydroacoustic demodulation system is affected by polarization fading, the signal- to-noise ratio of demodulated signals decreases, the reliability of the demodulation system decreases, and the instability becomes larger. In order to solve this problem, a differential cross-multiplication (DCM) demodulation algorithm based on polarization-switched optical path and combined demodulation is designed to demodulate the two interferometric signals with the squared sum of two visible degrees of 1 obtained from two orthogonal polarization states respectively, and output a signal that is not affected by polarization fading. The background noise of the demodulation system designed in this paper is reduced by 3 dB, and the average signal-to-noise ratio is kept above 30 dB to ensure the stability of the demodulation system.

articleTitle: Large-Scale Fingerprint Data Retrieval Based C-Means Clustering Model
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: In the field of biometric identification, fingerprints, as one of the most unique and persistent biometric features, are widely used for identification. With the popularity of fingerprint recognition in society, how to quickly retrieval fingerprints is a challenging task in large-scale databases. In order to ensure the accuracy of fingerprints retrieval , we propose a new retrieval model based on minutia features. We introduce fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm and Dijkstra algorithm.fuzzy C-means clustering is used to extract the detail point features in the fingerprint, Dijkstra algorithm to solve the shortest path of the minutia features.the number of features and the shortest path distance are compared to determine whether the fingerprints are the same. In this way, our method can achieve fast retrieval. In addition, we conducted extensive experiments on a large-scale datasets and tested the correctness of the experiments by different filtering levels to demonstrate the superiority of our method for fingerprint retrieval.

articleTitle: Construction of Electronic Information Science and Technology Network Simulation Training System under Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Under the background of educational informationization transformation and upgrading, facing the reform demand of the training mode of high-quality skilled information talents, colleges and universities should focus on solving the disadvantages of emphasizing theory over practice and results over process in the teaching of electronic information science and technology specialty. In this regard, this paper will start with practical teaching, based on virtual reality, visual interaction, Internet and other technologies, put forward the construction scheme of virtual simulation network practical training system, and promote the digital and intelligent transformation and upgrading of traditional teaching mode. The whole system is B/S architecture, relying on the MVC design pattern to call and control the business logic of the system, which promotes the high integration of remote login, virtual scene training, teaching resource application, data analysis and processing and other functional services, and innovatively introduces virtual simulation teaching methods into practical teaching practice. Experiments show that the functions of the system run stably, and the virtual scene training can have a high degree of reduction and immersion. With the help of AOI algorithm, the running load of the system is reduced and the concurrency control is improved, which makes a beneficial attempt to combine theoretical teaching with technical practice and create a new ecology of practical teaching.

articleTitle: Trust access control method of power metering automation system based on K nearest neighbor algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: In the process of trust access control of electric energy metering automation system, malicious attacks will lead to data leakage, tampering and loss. K-nearest neighbor algorithm can predict or classify the data samples according to the similarity of electric energy measurement, and restrict only authorized users to access and modify the data through access control means, thus effectively avoiding data leakage, tampering and loss. Therefore, a trust access control method for electric energy metering automation system based on K nearest neighbor algorithm is proposed. The trust degree is calculated according to the access request and attribute value of the subject, the reasonable degree of network security and information security is evaluated, and the access permission is granted according to the evaluation result of the trust degree. The implicit information is used to calculate the user's trust degree and dynamically adjust the user's authority; The information tobe collected at a fixed point is matched with the information in the power metering automation system by similarity, the nearest neighbor points are obtained, and the fuzzy entropy of each sample point is calculated according to the distance size. The weighted average method is used to predict the trust degree of the test samples. Based on K-nearest neighbor algorithm, accurate control of trust access to power metering automation system is realized. The simulation results show that this method has higher security and better dynamic planning ability of access path, and can complete the trust access control of power metering automation system in the shortest 2ms. It is proved that k-nearest neighbor algorithm can effectively complete the trust access control of electric power metering automation system.

articleTitle: Construction of a predictive model of college students' satisfaction with campus life based on intelligent algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: With the popularization and development of higher education, the study of college students' satisfaction with campus life has gradually attracted wide attention. The purpose of this study is to construct a predictive model combined with intelligent algorithms to accurately predict the satisfaction level of college students in campus life. In order to achieve this goal, we use a variety of data acquisition and analysis methods, combined with the advantages of intelligent algorithms, to conduct a comprehensive analysis and prediction of multiple dimensions of college campus life. In terms of data collection, we designed a questionnaire survey including personal information, academic performance, social participation, extracurricular activities and other factors, and extensively collected a large number of effective samples from many universities. Through the collection and collation of these data, we have established a rich data set, which provides sufficient support for the construction and training of the model.To sum up, by constructing a predictive model of campus life satisfaction based on intelligent algorithms, this study provides a powerful tool for college administrators to better understand and meet the needs of college students, so as to enhance the comprehensive competitiveness and reputation of colleges and universities. This study provides a valuable reference and method for the further study of college students' satisfaction with campus life.

articleTitle: Bayesian algorithm in library information social services research
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: The application of Library information service in social network is the concern of netizens, and how to develop intelligent recommendation service is an important topic for managers. In order to solve this problem, this paper uses "The Five Laws of Library Science" to build a model of influencing factors of library information application social network. A total of 302 valid questionnaires were collected. Reliability test was conducted after data preprocessing. Cronbach alpha=0.873 (>0.8), validity test KMO=0.799 (>0.7), indicating that the model has better quality. Then, the Bayesian network algorithm selected "library information management, social software application, user interest track" as the target variable, and "User reading needs, use of social software, user usage scenarios" as the dependent variable. The results show that: (1) We Chat users have high reading demand; (2) Data tracking is allowed when the demand is met; (3) We Chat users have a high demand for library information; (4) Consulting and reading services make the experience better; (5) It is more necessary to use intelligent recommendation in marketing; (6) Preferred learners focus on content sharing and timeliness. The research results help managers understand the application of personalized library and information service recommendation, so as to better meet the needs of users.

articleTitle: The clinical application value of MRA radiomics in distinguishing intracranial aneurysms from cerebrovascular
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: This study explores the diagnostic efficacy of radiomics models based on MRA for intracranial aneurysms (IA) and cerebrovascular. A retrospective examination was conducted on 82 IA patients verified by surgery or pathology and 20 healthy controls without IA. Ten percent of the data was randomly reserved as the final test set, while the remaining data was divided into training and validation sets in a 7:3 ratio. Using ITK-SNAP software after image standardization, neurosurgeons manually drew regions of interest (ROIs) on MRA images and then used Pyradiomics to extract features. The most diagnostic imaging radiomics features were screened using Student's t-test, MUSE selector, and least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) algorithms for feature dimensionality reduction. Different classification models were built, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves were drawn to assess each model's differential diagnostic efficacy. Thirteen imageomic characteristics were extracted from the MRA sequence, and classification models based on random forest [1] and logistic regression [2] were created with an area under curve (AUC) of 0.93 and 0.98 respectively in the test group. Therefore, it is useful to preoperatively differentiate between IA and cerebrovascular using an imaging radiomics model based on MRA.

articleTitle: Research on Cloud Computing Elastic Resource Allocation Method Based on Real time Operation and Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Conventional elastic allocation methods of cloud computing resources mainly use OFDMA (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multi-plexing Access) multi location access technology to share resource allocation information, which is vulnerable to the impact of the allocation adaptive rate, resulting in a low normalization rate of link resource allocation. Therefore, a new elastic allocation method of cloud computing resources needs to be designed based on real-time operation and maintenance. That is, based on real-time operation and maintenance, a cloud computing elastic resource allocation strategy is generated, and an efficient allocation and scheduling algorithm for cloud computing elastic resources is designed, thus realizing cloud computing elastic resource allocation. The experimental results show that the designed cloud computing elastic resource allocation method based on real-time operation and maintenance has good allocation effect, high link allocation normalization rate, effectiveness and certain application value, and has made certain contributions to improving the comprehensive utilization of cloud computing resources.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Man-machine Interaction Automatic Piano Accompaniment System Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: In order to understand the research of man-machine interaction automatic piano accompaniment system, a research and application of man-machine interaction automatic piano accompaniment system under artificial intelligence technology is put forward. In this paper, firstly, the composition system based on the algorithm of Hidden Markov Model (HMM) is improved, and a man-machine interactive music accompaniment sound type selection method is proposed, which enables users without music knowledge to create kind and pleasing music. The principle and theoretical support of man-machine interactive creation are given systematically. Secondly, the feasibility of man-machine interactive system is proved by experiments. Finally, three professional composers were invited to systematically evaluate the improved accompaniment results, and it was concluded that the computer composition system could create music works that the public liked.

articleTitle: An improved RepLKNet-based malware detection method
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Malware is seen as the biggest challenge to the Internet in decades, and the classfication of malware variants is the most critical research problem. Traditional malware detection methods suffer from high labor costs, database information delay, and low detection accuracy. This study proposes a deep learning method for typical malware data structures to solve the above problems. First, it visualizes the malware binaries and enhances GridMask data. Then, we build and train an improved RepLKNet model architecture, in which a multi-scale kernel uniting the deep large kernel convolution and the standard small one is employed, and a tuning optimization is performed. Finally, the final model training is completed, and classification is achieved. The results indicate that the model in this study is superior to others in malware family classification accuracy and achieves 99.25% accuracy on the Malimg dataset.

articleTitle: Research on the design and implementation plan of highly available cloud platform
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Building a highly available cloud platform aligns with future development trends and can bring about significant economic benefits. This article begins by discussing the necessity of constructing a highly available cloud platform and elaborates on the construction plan. It then provides a detailed analysis of the relevant ideas for building a highly available cloud platform, including the high availability framework, system reliability, design objectives, platform deployment, and security management. Finally, it discusses the feasibility of a highly available cloud platform, aiming to provide support for the construction of such a system.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for Building Energy Efficiency Analysis, Prediction, and Real-time Adjustment Strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: In the era of sustainable development, building energy efficiency stands out as a pivotal concern, given the significant energy consumption attributed to buildings globally. This paper introduces a novel approach, harnessing the power of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to analyze and predict energy inefficiencies using thermal imaging data. By training our model on a diverse dataset of thermal images from various buildings, we demonstrate the potential of CNNs in not only identifying energy inefficiencies but also suggesting real-time adjustment strategies. Preliminary results indicate a promising avenue for the integration of deep learning in the domain of sustainable architecture and building management.

articleTitle: Design and Establishment of Film and Television Recommendation Platform for Optimizing Cold Start Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Today's fast pace and accuracy is what every product merchant considers and what every user wants; and video production often cannot be focused or accurately recommended to users because of copyright issues. This situation makes it less easy for users to get the movies they really like through one platform. So the recommendation platform designed and developed in this paper is to solve the problem of information overload of today's movies and unclear user needs, making the whole recommendation service more personalized than the recommendation information brought by search engines. The recommendation algorithm of the platform mainly uses the most abundant and stable collaborative filtering algorithm based on data mining. A solution to the common cold-start problem in recommendation platforms is proposed. The specific steps are based on collaborative filtering algorithms to make recommendations combined with tag-based recommendations to avoid the vacancy of users' initial data. The platform will generate users' preferred tag values for the tags, and then update the corresponding preferred tag values after each review, and will select recommendations from the preferred tags when the rating data is insufficient or the recommended movies are insufficient; and the recommended list of preferred tags is recommended using the "hottest now" ranking. Eventually the platform can successfully complete two algorithmic recommendations of user CF and item CF based on the initial rating data, and recommend the hottest movies with similar interests at the initial use stage of new users; the mixed recommendation user preference values combined with tags will also be long involved in the subsequent movie and TV recommendations of users and gradually generate user interest-oriented.

articleTitle: A Method for Augmenting Camouflage Data Based on Texture Space Scrambling
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Data plays a crucial role in training deep learning models. To address the issue of insufficient sample size in the natural camouflage dataset, a data augmentation method based on texture space scrambling is proposed to effectively expand the sample size. Firstly, dynamic scrambling scales are selected based on the number of target pixels, and then the target area is divided into several texture blocks according to the scrambling scale. Finally, the spatial arrangement order of these texture blocks is scrambled. The experiments show that the data generated by the data augmentation method based on texture space scrambling has a similar data distribution to the original dataset. By training on the augmented dataset, the detection performance of the model has improved by 2.2%. Compared with traditional data augmentation methods, the proposed method achieves better results.

articleTitle: A research on warehouse logistics guided inbound and outbound operations simulation technology based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: The research on simulation and modeling of warehouse logistics operations based on 3D GIS technology is currently in a vacant stage. In response to the shortcomings of existing technologies, this paper creatively introduces the "guided" simulation and interactive modeling approach into the technical framework, highlighting the warehouse operation steps and key display content. Building upon the foundation of 3D GIS technology, a self-developed Cesium mechanism sampler component tool is utilized to generate path animations, bridging the research gap in this field. By combining multi-segment animations with GLTF/GLB format model data, a "guided" animation method is employed for realistic simulation demonstrations, making the practical process more vivid and authentic. Through analysis, design, and simulation of the workflow of warehouse logistics operations, the digitalized inbound and outbound processes are established, enabling personnel to better understand and master the relevant procedures and operational norms in real production activities.

articleTitle: Multimodal aspect level emotion recognition for attention interaction
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: In recent years, with the development of online social media, the form of content posted on the Internet has been transformed from a single text to an illustrated form. In the past, most aspect level sentiment analysis tasks only used text information, and the comment data included not only text, but also a lot of picture data. Therefore, a multimodal aspect level emotion recognition model based on attention interaction is proposed. The pre-trained language model BERT was used to obtain the embedding of text and aspect words. Features of aspect words were extracted by BiLSTM, local features and global features of text were obtained by convolutional network and BiLSTM, and image features were extracted by ResNet, a pre-training residual network. The attention mechanism is used to weight context representation and visual representation based on aspect words and the interaction between weighted modes. Experiments on Multi-ZOL data sets show that the proposed model can improve the performance of graphic-level emotion discrimination.

articleTitle: Construction mode of injection molding machine intelligent enterprise based on cloud-edge-terminal framework
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Currently, the development of the global manufacturing industry is moving towards digitization, intelligence and greenery. However, the injection molding machine industry, which plays a critical role in the entire manufacturing sector, still faces challenges such as slow information communication, low management efficiency, and difficulties in effectively controlling product quality. To this end, the paper proposes a smart enterprise construction model of the injection molding machine industry based on cloud-edge-terminal framework, including data terminal layer, edge services layer, and cloud processing layer. In data terminal layer, production and operation data is collected and standardized to form the data space, providing data support for the cloud processing layer and edge services layer. In cloud processing layer, the data is sent to the cloud platform for training and learning to generate corresponding models and algorithms for the edge service layer. In the edge layer, according to the data and the models, the services, such as workshop management, supply chain management, and remote operation and maintenance, are offered to realize the intelligence of the enterprise.

articleTitle: Detection method of trusted blockchain link flood attack based on trusted execution environment
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: In order to improve the detection accuracy and improve the detection speed, this paper designs a detection method of trusted blockchain link flood attack based on the trusted execution environment. First, above all, analyze the trusted block chain structure, then design the trusted block chain link flood attack detection algorithm, and finally the trusted execution environment is used to realize the trusted block chain link flood attack detection. The experimental results prove that the false alarm rate and leakage detection rate of the detection method of the flood flood attack designed based on the trusted execution environment are both low, with the lowest value only 3% and 0.98%. The detection accuracy is high, the detection time is short, and the detection can be completed in at least 13s. It can be proved that the performance of this design method is better and has certain application value.

articleTitle: Quality of Cigarette Cooperative Production Process Based on AHP Establishment and Application of Digital Management and Control Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: At present, with the in-depth development of a new round of scientific and technological revolution and industrial transformation, digital transformation has become the trend of the times, and the digital development of quality management in the cigarette industry is also undergoing profound changes. In order to effectively improve the product quality of cigarette co-production, the integration of digital technology and total quality management of co-production was strengthened, and the AHP method was used to effectively evaluate the quality control level of co-processing points, so as to establish and apply a new mode of digital quality control in co-production process. This study realizes the cleaning, statistical analysis and visualization of process quality data, the diagnosis of abnormal data and the evaluation and clustering of the quality level of cooperative manufacturers, which lays a solid foundation for the transformation and upgrading of cooperative production quality control to preventive type.

articleTitle: Sampling-based Self-Supervised Augmented Contrast Learning for Movie Recommendation Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: As the number of video users continues to grow, film and television have become one of the indispensable media in people’s lives. With this comes a huge explosion of information data, thus recommendation systems become one of the effective ways to solve information overload. We hope to research a better recommendation algorithm to further help provide more interesting movies to our users. In recent years, contrast learning has become a self-supervised learning paradigm that shows some effectiveness without labels. Graph neural networks have also been widely used in past recommender systems, but there are still problems of large overlap of interaction information, weak node representation, and long-tail distribution of user behavior. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes a movie recommendation system (SSACL) based on sampling-based self-supervised augmented contrast learning. Specifically, we learn node embeddings by constructing heterogeneous network views and meta-path views and project them into a multi-layer perceptron for contrast learning, while we employ graph augmentation methods such as resampling and edge discarding to assist in the recommendation task. Our aim is to leverage node-level information and the application of contrast learning to the recommendation task. Our empirical and ablation studies on two real datasets demonstrate that the SSACL model outperforms the current mainstream approaches.

articleTitle: Satisfaction Prediction for Heterogeneous Mobile Network Cells Based on Semi-supervised Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Semi-supervised and transfer learning are efficient methods to improve performance when labeled data is challenging to obtain. With the development of mobile communication network, the cellular mobile network system is becoming more and more complex, and there are more and more factors affecting the user satisfaction of mobile network. In order to solve the satisfaction optimization problem in the heterogeneous mobile cellular network, this article proposes a satisfaction prediction model for heterogeneous mobile network cells based on semi-supervised transfer learning (SP-SSTL). Firstly, SP-SSTL uses semi-supervised to train a model based on the source domain, which is user data. Then uses transfer learning to train a model based on the target domain, which is cellular network cell data. Meanwhile, the transfer learning model is fine-tuned using domain adaptation. Experimental results on different domains show that semi-supervised learning can significantly improve training efficiency and accuracy when labeled data is challenging to obtain; moreover, transfer learning can solve the problem of insufficient data volume in the target domain. Compared with the existing methods, our proposed method improved the accuracy by 15%, and the efficiency also significantly improved.

articleTitle: Cross-modal Traceability Method of Unstructured Multi-source Data Based on Knowledge Map Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: At present, the setting of cross-modal traceability nodes of unstructured multi-source data is mostly independent, and the processing efficiency of modal traceability is low, which leads to the increase of traceability difference. Therefore, the design and verification of cross-modal traceability method for unstructured multi-source data based on knowledge mapping technology are proposed. According to the current measurement, firstly, the trigger mechanism of data traceability is set, multi-objective method is adopted to improve the processing efficiency of modal traceability, and multi-objective traceability nodes are deployed. Based on this, the cross-modal traceability model of unstructured multi-source data of knowledge map is constructed, and the cross-modal traceability of data is realized by PBFT consensus processing. The test structure shows that the traceability difference of multi-source data is well controlled below 1.4 by comparing the selected six test cycles, which shows that with the assistance and support of knowledge mapping technology, the currently designed traceability processing structure of unstructured multi-source data is more flexible and changeable, with strong pertinence and stability, controllable errors and practical application value.

articleTitle: Application Practice of Network Physical Topology Digital Twin in Operator Network Operation and Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Under the background of Digital transformation of basic network operation and maintenance, this paper studies the network physical topology characterization from the edge node of the backbone network to the user end through the user network element penetration on the network side, and the relationship topology characterization from the business platform to the product and between the product and the user through the product penetration on the service side. We have carried out the application practice of digital twins in network physical topology, providing a three-dimensional visualization topology display of horizontal business logic topology and vertical link physical transmission topology. When there are network service exceptions, the network management system can quickly traverse and locate, complete the calculation of the fault impact range and extend clustering statistics to the user side, accurately provide physical information such as geographical location, port information, fiber optic cables, etc., and provide technical support for the rapid repair work of operation and maintenance personnel.

articleTitle: Study on the Impact of Digital Transformation and Tax Reduction on Enterprise Performance: Based on Big Data Analysis of Manufacturing Firms
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Against the backdrop of a booming digital economy, brick-and-mortar enterprises accelerate the transformation to digitalization and intelligence, and actively use big data and artificial intelligence technologies to fuel business development, as well as gradually presenting the form of digital-real integration and human-machine collaboration. The tax reduction policy is the most widely benefited policy for enterprises. Under the joint action of the two, it helps to promote industrial transformation and upgrading. Utilizing computers' superior computing power for big data analysis is uniquely advantageous for exploring the intrinsic connections between things. Therefore, adopting a fixed-effects model and using computer software, this paper conducts a big data analysis of manufacturing firms to explore the effect of tax cuts on business performance, and further discusses the moderating role of digital transformation. It is found that tax reduction significantly contributed to the improvement of corporate performance, and that digital transformation significantly as well as positively moderates the relationship between tax reduction and business performance. This article has some implications for the effective implementation of tax reduction policies and the enhancement of enterprises' digital technology capabilities.

articleTitle: Algorithm and Application of 3D Reconstruction of Deformed Pipeline Based on Point Cloud Data
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: In response to the problem of three-dimensional reconstruction of submarine deformed pipelines in reverse modeling engineering, an algorithm is proposed to directly extract the characteristic parameters of submarine deformed pipelines from scattered measurement data. The first step of the algorithm is to extract feature value data from seabed deformed pipeline data, and use the feature values to fit the cross-sectional contour lines of the seabed deformed pipeline surface. After filtering and denoising through data filtering, accurate cross-sectional contour lines and their centers are obtained. The second step is to determine the axis point coordinates of the pipeline surface from the center of the cross-sectional contour line. By using the scanning method, the axial interval is measured as the scanning sampling step, and the cross-sectional profile is uniformly swept along the axis direction. Then, Gaussian smoothing is applied to the overall profile to obtain a smooth and uniform pipeline model. This method can stably, efficiently, and accurately extract the deformation angle, orientation, and other information of underwater deformation pipelines.

articleTitle: Pyramid Selling Group Detection Method Based on Community Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet and mobile information technology, there are more and more social network groups. As a malignant group in the social network, the network pyramid selling group makes the pyramid selling crime more harmful and more difficult to track and investigate. In order to more effectively monitor and crack down on online pyramid selling crimes, it is necessary to explore the social activities of online pyramid selling, obtain and analyze its social network data, and quickly and accurately detect and discover online pyramid selling groups in social networks. Based on community detection technology, this paper analyzes the characteristics of pyramid selling in social networks, and proposes a pyramid selling group detection method combining social characteristics. This method sorts out and analyzes the text features and social attributes of pyramid selling, and uses local expansion technology for group detection. This paper also compares this method with several classical community detection algorithms in the application of pyramid selling group detection, which shows the effectiveness of the proposed method. The pyramid selling group detection method combined with social features can achieve an accuracy of 0.929, and is better than other methods in terms of precision, recall rate and F-measure.

articleTitle: Research On Vehicle Detection based on Ghost Net and Se Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: [Background] The safe obstacle avoidance of the automatic driving system relies on high-precision vehicle detection methods. The complexity of road conditions in the real world brings challenges to the realization of high-precision vehicle detection. At the same time, complex data processing and large-scale models are also problems that need to be urgently solved.[Method] This paper proposes an improved YOLOv5 vehicle detection technology, which is based on the YOLOv5s network structure and introduces a multi-strategy optimization framework. This framework reduces the size of the model and reduces the amount of calculation while improving the average detection accuracy. [Result] The experimental results show that, compared with the YOLOv5s model before improvement, the size of the improved model file best.pt is reduced by 34.0%, the amount of data calculation is reduced by 34.6%, and the average accuracy rate (mAP) is increased by 2.4%. The improved YOLOv5 algorithm can better realize vehicle detection.

articleTitle: Research on Data Security Technology in Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: With the widespread use of cloud computing, big data, blockchain and artificial intelligence, data security and privacy protection has become an important research topic in the cloud computing environment. In this paper, we propose a proof-of-data-possession (PDP) model based on blockchain and trusted third-party auditing, which aims to address the confidentiality, integrity and availability of data in the cloud environment. By combining blockchain and trusted third-party auditing technologies, the model achieves effective protection of data integrity and confidentiality, while leveraging the decentralized nature of blockchain to enable open and transparent verification of data holdings. In addition, experimental results show that the model has significant advantages over the traditional PDP model in terms of data security, data availability, and data integrity. Overall, this study provides a new solution for data security in cloud environments, which has theoretical and practical implications for both cloud service providers and users.

articleTitle: Rainfall Forecasting Based on Spatio-Temporal Information Fusion Using Informer
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Frequent flood disasters in China cause substantial economic losses and casualties each year, endangering lives and properties. However, existing machine learning-based flood prediction models encounter challenges in effectively extracting relevant data features, leading to suboptimal prediction accuracy and a higher risk of overfitting. To address these issues, this study proposes a deep learning approach that leverages diverse datasets to predict rainfall indicators. The research commences with an analysis of the topography of Zhejiang Province and the geographical distribution of monitoring stations, followed by data preprocessing. Subsequently, an enhanced Informer model is employed, integrating the Prob-attention module to overcome the limitations of previous models concerning long prediction lengths in data and to extract temporal and spatial features more effectively. Experimental results show that the model significantly outperforms traditional time series prediction algorithms, achieving better accuracy with average RMSE, MAPE, and R2 values of 0.39, 9.51%, and 0.91, respectively.

articleTitle: An algebraic method for TDOA-Based localization with sensor position errors
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Satellite position errors can have a significant impact on positioning performance. And the iterative algorithm is sensitive to initial values and has a high computational effort. In this paper, a closed-form solution algorithm including two stages is proposed for time difference of arrival (TDOA) localization based on weighted least squares (WLS) criterion to jointly estimate the source and satellite positions. The first stage ignores the equation constraints to obtain estimation results using WLS criterion. The second stage builds the optimization problem based on the results of the first stage and equation constraints, and obtains the final results based on WLS criterion. Simulations show that the proposed algorithm can to achieve the constrained Cramer-Rao lower bound (CCRLB) and is smaller in computational effort.

articleTitle: Request Smuggling Via HTTP/2 Cleartext in the Wild: Empirical Testing with Differential Fuzzing
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: The Request Smuggling Via HTTP/2 Cleartext (H2C Smuggling) attacks exploit vulnerabilities in the handling of HTTP request headers by proxy servers, allowing attackers to bypass security measures such as WAFs and gain unauthorized access to internal resources. We developed an experimental infrastructure that utilizes a grammar-based differential fuzzer to test 18 widely-used Connect Direct Network (CDN)/Web Application Firewall (WAF)/Load Balancing technologies. Through this testing, we identified vulnerabilities that can be exploited to carry out H2C Smuggling attacks.

articleTitle: Database intrusion risk data localization method based on improved ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Database intruders usually take covert measures to hide their attacks and traces, so that the intrusion activities are not easy to be detected. This brings great challenge to database security management. Therefore, a database intrusion risk data location method based on improved ant colony algorithm is proposed. The optimization method of ant foraging path was improved, and the ant colony algorithm was optimized. Sample database intrusion based on improved ant colony algorithm. Using the sample object to mark the database intrusion behavior, based on this, the database intrusion risk data location algorithm is designed. To verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, an experiment is designed. Under the research method, the proportion of correct identification of database intrusion risk data and the proportion of real attack behavior in the targeted attack data can reach more than 99%. The length of the intrusion field located by the research method is consistent with the actual value. The experimental results show that the research method has ideal applicability.

articleTitle: Deployment of Multi-Service Network Slices for Integrated Space and Ground Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: This paper presents a solution to the problem of managing and supporting mobile services with different quality of service requirements in a space-ground integrated network that has limited resources. To this end, we apply network slicing technology and present a reliable deployment algorithm for multi-service network slicing. Specifically, the network slice deployment problem is transformed into a mixed integer linear programming model, and virtual nodes are sorted and deployed using the breadth-first search algorithm based on their reliability index. Finally, virtual link deployment solutions are provided on demand for different types of network slices. Simulation experiments demonstrate that compared to traditional service function chain mapping algorithms, our proposed algorithm reduces deployment costs while increasing network resource utilization and reliability.

articleTitle: Design of Heterogeneous Cloud Application Software Resources Automatic Delivery System
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: In the current automatic delivery system of heterogeneous cloud application software resources, due to insufficient server design, the system has a high packet loss rate. Therefore, the design of heterogeneous cloud application software resources automatic delivery system is proposed. In terms of hardware design, design a five tier architecture heterogeneous resource server and power supply device. In terms of software design, the resource processing module and automatic resource delivery module of cloud application software are designed. Experiments show that the average packet loss rate of the system is only 0.155%, which has high practical application value.

articleTitle: During the COVID-19 pandemic Weibo topic change analysis and visualization
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: This paper hopes to study and grasp the law of its influence on people's emotions, which can provide decision-making basis for scientific governance, and enhance governance level and governance ability in the face of sudden major public health events. This study conducted an in-depth analysis of the daily Weibo hot search entries from December 2019 to March 2023, which spanned nearly three years. By analyzing the changes in microblog topics during the COVID-19 epidemic and the thematic characteristics of public information at different stages of public health emergencies, it explored the changes in the emotions and concerns of netizens at various stages of the epidemic development. On the whole, in the early and middle period of the epidemic, the public focused mainly on self-related information such as mentality adjustment and self-management of the epidemic; in the later period, the public focused mainly on information related to social behaviors such as return to work and epidemic prevention. Meanwhile, entertainment themes appeared in the center of public attention. In general, the focus of public attention has shifted from self-related to external attention. To some extent, it reflects a positive shift in public sentiment.

articleTitle: Research on parallel detection of heterogeneous cloud resources with multiple anomalies in cross-type database
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: In the current multi anomaly parallel detection of heterogeneous cloud resource cross database, the processing of data characteristics is insufficient, resulting in low accuracy of detection results. Therefore, this paper proposes the research on multi anomaly parallel detection of heterogeneous cloud resource cross database. Preprocess heterogeneous cloud resource cross data. Select the local features of the data for depth feature synthesis. Analyze the deviation relationship of core indicators of anomaly detection. Parallel detection of database multiple abnormal behaviors. The experiment shows that the average accuracy rate of the detection results of this research method is 0.987927, which has been greatly improved and has high practical application value.

articleTitle: Domain Terminology Knowledge Graph Completion Method Based on Bert
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Domain terminology knowledge graphs play a critical role in many applications such as text retrieval and information extraction. However, most domain knowledge graphs are constructed manually and often be incomplete on the relation. To this end, we propose a bert-based relational prediction model, which extract relations between entities automatically. Concretely, we utilize the definition of domain terminologies as context of BERT and add special characters to the input of the model to capture the semantic features of domain terms. Through this method, the model can effectively obtain the semantic information of terminology definition and predict the relationship between them. The experimental results demonstrate that our model achieves significant improvement over the baselines on the domain-specific dataset.

articleTitle: An Energy Consumption Optimization Strategy for Mobile Edge Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Edge computing involves shifting computational and storage capabilities from centralized cloud computing centers to the edge of the network, allowing edge servers deployed at the edge to respond to user requests. This approach eliminates the need for users to traverse the uplink from the edge network to the cloud computing center when initiating a business request, as well as the downlink from the cloud computing center when returning the computed results, significantly reducing transmission time. However, as latency requirements continue to increase, meeting higher latency demands will inevitably lead to the deployment of a large number of edge servers. The consequent energy consumption problem has become a pressing issue for service providers today. Studies have shown that user business requests are unevenly distributed over time, with periods of high and low demand. To cope with the uncertainty of user business requests and respond quickly, many edge servers remain idle or operate at low business volume, leading to significant energy consumption even when idle. This paper proposes a centralized server-controlled edge device hibernation strategy based on upper and lower thresholds, aiming to minimize the overall energy consumption of all edge servers in the system while meeting user latency requirements. By dividing time slots under upper and lower threshold monitoring, the paper analyzes the load conditions of each edge server in the system during each time slot and assigns computing task migration through the central server to reduce the number of idle and low-business volume edge servers, ultimately achieving the minimization of overall system energy consumption.

articleTitle: Research on Accounting Information Distortion Recognition Model of Listed Companies Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: This paper employs machine learning techniques for the detection of accounting information distortion within publicly listed companies. It takes a comprehensive approach, utilizing various machine learning methods to classify accounting information as either distorted or non-distorted. This classification is based on a profound understanding of pertinent theories and a thorough analysis of existing literature. The study initially derives its index system through a comprehensive review of existing literature. Subsequently, financial reports from Chinese listed companies spanning the years 2008 to 2017 are chosen as the research dataset. Six distinct models for recognizing accounting information distortion are established. The classification results across these six recognition models reveal that the "K-nearest neighbor (K-NN) model" boasts the highest accuracy in classification recognition, achieving an impressive 83.86%. In contrast, the naïve Bayes (NB) classification exhibits the least accurate recognition performance. Then, the model evaluation and the construction of a comprehensive recognition model are carried out, and the decision tree model emerges as the most effective classification model based on the evaluation results, with an accuracy of 83.17%. Finally, combined with the research of this paper, suggestions are put forward at the levels of research methods and business management.

articleTitle: Short-term industrial load forecasting based on Bi-LSTM optimized by SSA and Dropout
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Accurate prediction of industrial load is a crucial step in the development of smart grids. Industrial load forecasting is fundamentally a time series forecasting problem. Traditional time series forecasting models struggle to accurately predict complex industrial load changes due to their nonlinearity, time series nature, and unstationarity. Neural network models, with their robust self-learning capabilities, can effectively process industrial load data. However, these models are prone to overfitting and uncertainty issues arising from manual parameter adjustments based on experience during training. Moreover, the inability to handle bidirectional data propagation causes conventional neural network models to lose essential load data characteristics and interrelated data information.In this paper, we propose an SSA-Dropout-Bi-LSTM prediction model based on a sliding window. First, the Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) neural network theory is employed to facilitate bidirectional information transfer. Dropout technique is utilized to decrease the model's overfitting degree. The sparrow search algorithm (SSA) is further used to search for the optimal hyperparameters of the Dropout-Bi-LSTM model. The model's parameter search uncertainty is reduced by dynamically adjusting parameters through the machine learning algorithm, thereby enhancing the neural network model's generalization ability. We conducted load forecasting for six industrial users in Zhejiang province. The proposed model's Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) on the test set averages at 3.75%, an improvement compared to other combinations of LSTM models (4.17%-5.37%), and a significant enhancement compared to RNN (7.22%) and GRU (5.94%). The mean coefficient of determination (R2) of the proposed model is 94.34%, which is considerably higher than RNN (87.58%) and GRU (90.28%). In comparison, the proposed model demonstrates higher prediction accuracy and better model fitting effects.

articleTitle: Design of Healthcare Blockchain Systems to Support Accessible Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Edge computing is an extension of IoT evolution and cloud computing technology development, which is closer to data sources and can provide low-latency and high-bandwidth service support to end users. In this paper, we propose a blockchain-enabled offloading method for edge computing to address the data silos and high latency of service delivery in the healthcare industry, using a cloud-edge-chain three-layer underlying architecture model to achieve a joint design of task offloading and blockchain updates to improve the quality of healthcare services, and blockchain technology to provide authentication for edge service nodes to improve system security, data traceability, and user identity management. The results show that compared with the traditional reinforcement learning Q-learning algorithm, the computational offloading method of the DRLO algorithm designed in this paper converges faster and can effectively reduce the total system processing latency under the same conditions, with a 26% reduction in system processing latency and a 9.2% increase in reward value. Meanwhile, with the change of local terminal computing resources, the algorithm proposed in this paper can still keep the total system latency at a low level.

articleTitle: CGKDP: Concurrent Group Key Distribution Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Traditional tree-based multicast key management protocols rarely satisfy forward secrecy (FS), post-compromise security (PCS), and anonymity .Moreover, they do not consider the inefficiency and security risks that might arise from multiple concurrent user requests .To address these issues, this article proposes a concurrent group key distribution protocol based on the updatable symmetric key encryption (USKE) technology .Based on both theoretical analysis and simulation experiments, we conclude that we gained a significant efficiency advantage when facing multiple concurrent user requests while ensuring the necessary level of security.

articleTitle: Application Practice of AI Intelligent Technology in Customer Service of China Telecom
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Digital transformation is an important direction of enterprise development. At present, China Telecom is facing problems such as high cost of service channel construction and low service efficiency. Therefore, China Telecom has carried out digital transformation research represented by "AI Digital Business Hall", using advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence, Internet of things, face recognition, voice recognition and so on, to quickly meet the demands of users with intelligent means. At present, it has achieved good results in Guangdong, Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Wuhan and other provinces.

articleTitle: Data resources catalog creation method across oil and gas industry chain
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Information Technology: IoT and Smart City (ITIoTSC)
abstract: Oil and gas exploration and excavation is a capital and technological intense traditional industry with a long business chain, involving many specialized professions and complex interactions between specialized fields. Optimization and improvement of the overall business process is a complex systematic project, requiring frequent utilisation of new technologies such as digitalisation and intelligence. Only by integrating conventional human business experience with data analysis can we achieve the goal of digital transformation and efficiency improvement. The existing information systems, originally constructed separately by different business departments, are continuously expanding in terms of business insight, scale, data volume and complexity. To facilitate the innovative use of cross-domain and cross-dimension business data, it is urgent to break down the barrier between these different systems. This paper proposes a feasible method of creating a data resource catalog for entire oil and gas industry chain, and a "unified catalog, list and capital" for the business data can be established. This catalog can effectively support the fusion of digitization and industrialization, improve data quality, enhance data sharing and supporting the application of big data analysis, thus, significantly promoting the transformation into a data-driven enterprise.
